entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,750 star（日均约 821，相对存量增速 4.5%），累计 128,565 star、8,151 fork。窗口内被 fork 415 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，468 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,750 stars over the last 7 days (~821/day, 4.5% of its base), now at 128,565 stars and 8,151 forks. 415 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 468 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一款 AI 编程平台，能让你在桌面、移动或云端同时运行多个编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）。它把每个代理放进独立工作树，支持聊天、终端、diff 审查、浏览器等多种交互方式。
intro.en: Orca is an AI coding platform that lets you run multiple coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) in parallel across desktop, mobile, or cloud. Each agent lives in its own worktree, and you can chat, use a terminal, review diffs, or drive a browser—all in one app.

cardLine.zh: 一站式 AI 编程平台，支持多代理并行运行与交互。
cardLine.en: All‑in‑one AI coding hub that runs multiple agents in parallel and lets you chat, terminal‑style, or review diffs.

highlights.zh: 可在桌面、iOS、Android 上使用，支持远程服务器和云 VM。
highlights.en: Runs on desktop, iOS, Android, remote servers, and cloud VMs.

highlights.zh: 通过聊天或 CLI 交互，轻松切换上下文而不丢失信息。
highlights.en: Switch between chat UI and raw CLI without losing context.

highlights.zh: 自动拆分大任务，启动工作者代理并汇总结果。
highlights.en: Orchestrates large tasks by spawning worker agents and consolidating their outputs.

highlights.zh: 集成 GitHub、Linear，直接在 PR 中生成提交信息或修复错误。
highlights.en: Integrates with GitHub and Linear to draft commits, PRs, and auto‑fix failures.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 8,440 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 8,440 open issues — high relative to its star count

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)
# Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask.
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin

entries.name: graphify
entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 3,548 star（日均约 507，相对存量增速 2.4%），累计 149,979 star、14,412 fork。窗口内被 fork 442 次，最近一次提交在 1 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，400 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 3,548 stars over the last 7 days (~507/day, 2.4% of its base), now at 149,979 stars and 14,412 forks. 442 new forks in the window; last push 1 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 400 contributors.

intro.zh: Graphify 能把任何代码库（含文档、SQL、PDF 等）转成可查询的知识图谱，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 助手。它不使用向量索引，而是基于 AST 的确定性解析，完全本地运行。
intro.en: Graphify turns any codebase—including docs, SQL, PDFs—into a queryable knowledge graph, usable with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more. It uses deterministic AST parsing, no vector index, and runs entirely locally.

cardLine.zh: 将代码库转成可查询的知识图谱，支持多 AI 助手，完全本地解析。
cardLine.en: Convert codebases into a queryable knowledge graph, supporting multiple AI assistants, all locally parsed.

highlights.zh: 使用 tree-sitter AST，解析确定且不离开本机。
highlights.en: Deterministic parsing with tree-sitter AST, staying on the local machine.

highlights.zh: 每条边都标记为 EXTRACTED 或 INFERRED，能清晰追踪来源。
highlights.en: Each edge is labeled EXTRACTED or INFERRED, making source traceability clear.

highlights.zh: 支持文档、PDF、图片、视频的语义解析，使用模型或 API 关键字。
highlights.en: Semantic parsing of docs, PDFs, images, videos via model or configured API key.

highlights.zh: 可通过 `/graphify` 在 AI 助手中查询，替代 grep。
highlights.en: Query the graph with `/graphify` in your AI assistant, replacing grep.

entries.name: archify
entries.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,862 star（日均约 266，相对存量增速 1.9%），累计 97,665 star、6,666 fork。窗口内被 fork 139 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，86 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,862 stars over the last 7 days (~266/day, 1.9% of its base), now at 97,665 stars and 6,666 forks. 139 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 86 contributors.

intro.zh: Archify 是一个让 AI 代理把任何想法、计划或代码库转化为交互式图表的工具。只需向代理描述你的需求，它就能生成可探索、可自定义、可分享的 HTML 视觉化。
intro.en: Archify lets AI agents turn any idea, plan, or codebase into an interactive diagram. Just describe what you want, and the agent produces an explorable, customizable HTML visual you can share.

cardLine.zh: 让 AI 代理把想法变成交互式图表，支持 Claude、Codex 等多种代理。
cardLine.en: Turn ideas into interactive diagrams with AI agents—works with Claude, Codex, and more.

highlights.zh: 无需代码仓库，直接描述想法即可生成图表。
highlights.en: Generate diagrams from plain descriptions—no repository needed.

highlights.zh: 支持多种代理（Claude、Codex、Cursor 等）一键调用。
highlights.en: Works with Claude, Codex, Cursor, and other agents.

highlights.zh: 生成的 HTML 可自定义主题、导出 PNG/PDF，便于分享与展示。
highlights.en: Export diagrams as PNG, PDF, or a single HTML file with light/dark themes.

highlights.zh: 图表支持源代码链接和引用，方便验证与检查。
highlights.en: Diagram nodes link to source code and cite references for easy verification.
